b5f029-fix-timing.question: When are B5F-029's three round-13 findings fixed?

options.summary: all three now, before T005, T004 code only, each with its failing case first
all three inside T008, which reworks the review authority and removes the per-round approval (FR-010)
split: finding 1 (another family's phrase takes a boundary packet's window) now; findings 2 and 3 (withdrawal lock, partial sign-off spend) with T008, which removes or changes the round-approval slot

verdict-pairing-out-of-tail.question: How does a verdict pair when its packet has left the transcript tail?

options.summary: pair by time at Stop: the first typed verdict after the crossing recorded_at
stay marker-bound and read the whole transcript
stay marker-bound and report; the human retypes after the packet is shown again

at the message own prompt event, a reply naming the target boundary pairs with the durable crossing if its packet was verified as shown in this session (a compaction keeps shown; new, resume and clear do not) and the linked files are unchanged; Stop never pairs without the waiting crossing marker and reports what it did not record

verdict-pairing-out-of-tail.rationale: an approval can only come from the message being sent or from a reply to a visible marker, so DEC-198-GOV-003 stays disabled with no redesign; the cost is one retype if the prompt hook misses
